column2:
Risk Assessment 1 (RA1)
Intel conducts a high-level (one-page) analysis for new 
suppliers to determine whether a specific supplier facility 
is a potential high-risk facility. The assessment covers 
a number of risk factors, plus geographic location, 
product(s) or service(s) provided, and corporate 
responsibility concerns.
All top Tier 1 and high-risk suppliers move to RA2
column4:
Risk Assessment 2 (RA2)
Requires a supplier to respond to an in-depth, online 
self-assessment questionnaire with more than 300 
questions to determine a facility’s potential high-risk 
areas. RA2 goes into greater detail than RA1 and covers 
all sections of the EICC Code. All of our top Tier 1 
suppliers are required to have RA2s completed.
High-risk suppliers move to RA3
column6:
Risk Assessment 3 (RA3)
Consists of an on-site third-party audit conducted for 
customers. The audit covers all sections of the EICC Code 
and evaluates risk according to the number of compliance 
concerns and/or critical areas at that location.
Audit completed and corrective action plan put in place
